cases.rationale: The blue post at the right has an identifiable parking-meter head and paid-parking dial/body. The doorway, wall lamps and fabric entrance awning are not a traffic signal, umbrella or furniture; the meter dial is not a clock. I considered each of the 75 frozen definitions against the whole crop; no other defined object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual zebras have clearly striped bodies, heads and legs. A giraffe behind them has its distinctive patterned long neck and body. These are zebras rather than horses, and the background greenery lacks pots. The dark background structure does not identify any listed furniture or vehicle. I considered every one of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The foreground tennis player and the people beyond the fence are actual humans. A red-rimmed strung racket head is visible immediately right of the central pole in a tennis-court context, supporting tennis racket. The poles, netting and court markings are not other defined objects. All 75 definitions were individually considered across the crop, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A real roadside red octagonal stop-sign face on a post is identifiable despite the heavy snow obscuring most lettering. Its exposed red face, border and octagonal form support stop-sign identity; the snow and branches are not animals or other listed objects. I explicitly considered all 75 frozen definitions. There is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two people are visible above an actual motorcycle, whose long saddle, engine, rear suspension and wheel identify it rather than a bicycle. The standing person holds the upright shaft of an open umbrella with a small checkered canopy portion visible along the top edge. The saddle is not a chair or bench, and the dark clothing is not an identifiable bag. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A metal eating fork with handle and multiple tines is prominent over food on a flat plate. The red rounds are tomatoes rather than apples or oranges, the green pieces are not identifiable broccoli, and the pale slices do not establish any listed food category. The narrow dark surface beyond the plate could be an eating table or another support, so dining table remains unclear. The plate is not a bowl. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered; no other category ambiguity remains.

An actual steam locomotive and attached carriages run on visible rails, clearly supporting train. The partially cut off upright assembly at the upper-right edge has colored circular details that might be a traffic/rail signal, but too little is visible to identify its signal head confidently, so traffic light is unclear. The engine's round front lamps are train parts, not independent traffic lights. I considered all 75 definitions and found no other identifiable listed object or unresolved category distinction.

The large real pilot boat is identifiable from its hull, cabin, windows, mast and tire fenders. The tires are boat fenders rather than bicycle parts or flying discs. No person is identifiable through the dark windows; the foreground consists of shoreline rocks. Each of the 75 frozen definitions was considered across the crop, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Many actual people stand around a long eating/serving table covered with open pizza boxes. The round and rectangular crust-and-topping foods are identifiable pizzas, not sandwiches or cake. A small drinking cup with a red straw is visible near the far end of the table. The tabletop's food-serving context supports dining table. Printed signs and pizza boxes are not bound books or displays. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The whole poultry carcass has identifiable actual bird torso, wing and leg anatomy, so bird is present even though it is prepared as food. It rests in a rectangular foil roasting tray, which is not a drinking vessel or bowl. The dark background and horizontal upper edge may belong to an oven cavity, but the close framing leaves the appliance identity insufficiently established; oven is unclear. All 75 frozen definitions were considered, with no other unresolved category ambiguity.

A standalone computer monitor, separate keyboard and computer mouse are clearly present on a work desk. The landscape on the monitor and the framed picture are depicted images, not actual category objects. The monitor is not an integrated laptop, and the upright networking/electronic devices are not identifiable phones or remotes. Thin stacked white items clipped at the far-left edge could be bound booklets or loose paper, so book remains unclear. The desktop is a work desk rather than a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered.

Small passenger cars are visible on the roadway toward the intersection and at the right edge, with recognizable car bodies/windows. Actual suspended traffic-signal heads show illuminated red lamps. The large green directional highway sign is not a stop sign, and the bare tree and roadside vegetation are not potted plants. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions against the entire crop; no other listed object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.
